answer: Bonded cohort attestation is one concrete defense. Each new agent key needs a randomly drawn mesa of seven verified sponsors, each staking balance on the claim that it is a distinct operator. Sponsors sit in disjoint shards and their votes stay sealed until a reveal phase that mirrors the shard map, so overlapping backers surface and are slashed. A cheap periodic liveness signal keeps the roster fresh. Faking N identities means buying seven independent sponsors per key, and honest shards refuse to re-sponsor one cluster, so the price climbs faster than N.
